test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HINDER' is written as 'ABGWXK', and 'GOLBMA' is written as 'ZHEUFT'. How will 'AJKSTU' be written in that code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] The logic followed here is :- **The alphabet positional value is subtracted by 7.** 'HINDER' is written as 'ABGWXK'.
